arabic text: AA JAA-O CHAND MERE, TERI PYAAS ME BUJHAA-OON,\nASGHAR ME TERI MAA HOON
english translation text: COME MY DEAR, LET ME QUENCH YOUR THIRST,\nASGHAR, I AM YOUR MOTHER

arabic text: MERE LAADLE KAHAN HO, SEENE TUMHE LAGAA-OON,\nASGHAR ME TERI MAA HOO
english translation text: WHERE ARE YOU MY DEAR, LET ME HUG YOU,\nASGHAR, I AM YOUR MOTHER

arabic text: BETA TUMHARA QATIL, MERE SAAMNE KHARRAA HE,\nJAANE KYUN HASS RAHAA HE\nCHADAR BHI LUT GAYI HE, MUH KIS TARHAA CHUPAA-OON
english translation text: MY SON, YOUR KILLER IS STANDING NEARBY,\nSMILING FOR NO REASON,\nMY VEIL HAS BEEN LOOTED, HOW DO I SEEK COVER

arabic text: TERE JHOOLE KO SAKINA, RO RO KE CHOOMTI HE, TUJHE GHAR ME DHOONDTI HE,\nTERI MOWT KI KHABAR ME, KAISE USSE SUNAA-OON
english translation text: SAKINA IS CLINGING TO YOUR CRADLE, WEEPING & YEARNING FOR YOU,\nLOOKING FOR YOU IN THE HOUSE,\nHOW DO I CONVEY YOUR MARTYDOM NEWS TO HER

arabic text: MERI JAAN JAA RAHI HE, YAH SOCH SOCH ASGHAR,, ISS PHOOL SE GALE PAR,\nYEH TEER KAISE JHELA, BEHNO KO KYAA BATAWU
english translation text: I AM LOSING MY MIND WONDERING,\nHOW SUCH A DELICATE NECK OF YOURS, WITHSTOOD AN ARROW, WHAT SHALL I TELL YOUR SISTERS

arabic text: NEZE SE GHIR RAHA HE, NANNA SA SAR TUMHAARA, DIL ROTA HE HAMARA,\nMERE HAATH TO BANDHE HE, SAR KISTARHA UUTHAWUU
english translation text: YOUR SMALL HEAD FALL FROM THE SPEAR-HEAD, IT BREAKS MY HEART,\nMY HANDS ARE TIED, I CAN’T EVEN LIFT MY HEAD

arabic text: JHULE KE SAATH BETA, MERE HAATH JAL GAYE HE, ZALIM BHI HASS RAHE HAI,\nTERI AAKHRI NISHANI, HAYE KIS TARHA BACHAA-OON
english translation text: MY HANDS BURNT, ALONG WITH YOUR CRADLE,\nTHE OPRESSORS KEEP MOCKING US,\nHOW DO I PRESERVE YOUR FINAL SIGN

arabic text: JAB RAAT HOGI RAN ME, HO JAAYEGA ANDHERA, DARNA NAHI EH BETA,\nDAADI KAHENGI TUMSE, AA ME TUJHE SULAAOO
english translation text: WHEN NIGHT FALLS ON THE DESERT, IT WILL BE DARK,\nDON’T GET SCARED O’ SON,\nYOUR GRNADMOTHER WILL CONSOLE & PUT YOU TO SLEEP

arabic text: TUM RAAT KO HAMESH, SUNTE THE MAA SE LORI, AB NEENDH AATI HOGI,\nPHIR GOWD ME LITAA KAR, NAADE ALI SUNAA-OON
english translation text: EVERY NIGHT YOU WOULD LISTEN MY LULLABIES, NOW YOU MUST BE SLEEPY,\nLET ME AGAIN PUT YOU IN MY LAP, AND RECITE NAD-E-ALI TO YOU
